name: AK17-Portable Air Quality Monitor Household HCHO TVOC Monitor Home Digital Air Quality Detector Multifunctional Formaldehyde Tester Air Analyzer
highlights: Real Time Monitoring: This air quality detector provides continuous tracking of HCHO and TVOC concentrations for consistent data updates in indoor environments.
Integrated LCD Display: The large digital screen shows two data sets simultaneously to eliminate the need for manual screen switching during operation.
Simple Operation: This air analyzer offers quick detection capabilities and is designed for straightforward use without complex configuration requirements.
Audible Alert System: A built in buzzer provides an automatic notification when concentration levels reach the 0.1 mg per cubic meter threshold.
Versatile Placement: The portable design is suitable for use in offices, classrooms, kitchens, and residential areas with new furniture or recent decorations.
